name: Mitten Extracts | 2g Disposable 2-In-1 Flip | Cola Zlurpee + Cherry Zlurpee
description: Why choose one flavor when you can have two? The Cola Zlurpee x Cherry Zlurpee 2G 2-in-1 Disposable lets you switch between crisp cola and sweet cherry or enjoy both throughout your session. Inspired by classic fountain drink flavors, this dual-flavor device delivers a nostalgic, candy-like experience with every flip.
